title: Plugin runs heavy logic on broad events
summary: A Joomla plugin performs expensive work on global events that fire across many page requests.
rationale: Broad event hooks amplify computation even when the work is only needed for a subset of pages.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Narrow event scope, short-circuit early, and move expensive logic behind explicit conditions.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
